closureEncoding: SHA256 of JSON.stringify of ordered OS/architecture rows; packages sorted by import path; path, module and selected version; stdlib go1.27.2; main-module packages additionally bind relative sourceDirectory and sorted actual GoFiles.
firstPartySourceEncoding: SHA256 of JSON.stringify of all cmd/internal Go source path and SHA256 pairs sorted by relative path; contents normalized to UTF-8 LF. All actual main-module production GoFiles must be covered. Generated .pb.go and .proto files or symlinks require a new review.

review.summary: RC9 first-party source inventory (899 Go files) and six Go 1.27.2 target closures were independently re-hashed. Linux amd64/arm64 closures include all eight changed production Go files; Darwin/Windows closures include internal/version/version.go only. The selected graph, 106-module production set, go.mod/go.sum, and 36 bounded scan-scope records are unchanged from RC8. Actual/original RC9 closure equality, the official vulnerability scanner, and the full security audit remain separate checks and are not claimed here.
